name: Four dollars
note: Doc 23. Depleting, and gone after puzzle A3 -- doc 02 has Vessel take it along with the watch.

LOOK_AT.say: Four dollars. It was eleven when I left Providence and the difference is entirely the fault of a coach line.
repeat: Four dollars. A room is five.
Four dollars. I have counted it twice and it has not improved.

LISTEN_TO.say: Coin, in a pocket. Not a great deal of it.
repeat: Nothing. It is four dollars and it is being quiet about it.
